scope: Static contract, token, provenance, isolation, commerce-policy and dataset validation of the MC-17 implementation.
knownLimitations: Automated checks do not replace the independent review or the Playwright accessibility/keyboard/visual suites.
Production-bundle scanning is skipped when dist/embarcarte is absent in the run environment.

checks.description: Token contract keeps internal/provisional governance status
checks.detail: INTERNAL_PROPOSED / NOT_ADOPTED / NO_GO

checks.detail: 33 roles x 4 modes

checks.description: Night mode uses no pure black canvas or pure white text
checks.detail: night palette avoids #000000 and #ffffff

checks.description: All declared contrast pairs pass their threshold in every mode
checks.detail: 296 pair/mode measurements

checks.description: Token outputs are deterministic and current
checks.detail: token, fixture and baseline generators report current
